signal: Super Dispatch published its second annual State of Auto Transport report and is pushing AI dispatch tooling; platform now moves nearly 1,000,000 vehicles monthly

email.subject1: a signal play for Super Dispatch
email.body1:
Stan, saw Super Dispatch dropped its second State of Auto Transport report and is leaning hard into AI dispatch, now moving close to a million vehicles a month.

At that scale the brokers and carriers worth reaching outnumber what reps can personally work. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Super Dispatch off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Stan, quick follow-up for Super Dispatch.

As the category grows, board expectations on pipeline tend to climb faster than headcount, and most teams cannot say how many meetings they need to hit the new number. The gap shows up late, and recovering a quarter is brutal.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Super Dispatch needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Stan, last bit of proof for Super Dispatch.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Super Dispatch's reply rate likely compares to similar B2B platforms. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Stan, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding reps is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters, and a CRO's calendar rarely cooperates.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a logistics-software motion? I will tailor it to Super Dispatch either way.
